query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
                (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - c.created_at)) / 3600.0)::float8
            ), 0.0)::float8
            FROM cards c
            INNER JOIN columns col ON col.id = c.current_column_id
            WHERE c.workspace_id = $1
              AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND c.is_archived = FALSE
              AND col.is_done = FALSE
